confirmed_decisions.decision: Employees with 30 or more completed service years continue to use the 20-30-year employee leave tier, and the existing 50-day maximum-accrual warning applies to every default leave type.

confirmed_decisions.decision: The 0-10-year, 10-20-year and 20-30-plus-year employee leave types carry remaining days into the next year; sickness and pregnancy leave types do not carry remaining days into the next year.
All leave quotas, balances, usages and requests are non-negative multiples of 0.5 day; half-day requests remain supported, while automatic proration rounds down to a whole integer day.
confirmed_decisions.evidence: FOLLOWUP_USER_APPROVAL: yarım günlük izinler kalsın. Çalışan izinleri 30 gün, 30.5 gün, 31 gün gibi olsun, 0.5 dışındaki ondalık sayılar olmasın; dediğin gibi yap, yuvarla ve tam sayı şeklinde hesapla

confirmed_decisions.decision: The entitlement worker reconciles every local calendar day; a new employee is granted a calendar-day prorated, whole-day-rounded-down entitlement from StartDate through December 31 without waiting for January 1.
confirmed_decisions.evidence: CURRENT_USER_REQUEST: İzinler background worker ile her yeni günde kontrol edilip güncellenmeli. O yıl içinde yeni gelen çalışanlar için 1 ocağı beklemek yerine geldiği gibi yıl sonuna kadar olan süre için izni hesaplanmalı.

confirmed_decisions.decision: Employees request only Annual Leave or Sickness Leave. Annual Leave aggregates all service-tier balances and deducts persisted allocations from carry-over first, then entitlement, in 0-10, 10-20, 20-30-plus tier order.
confirmed_decisions.evidence: FOLLOWUP_USER_APPROVAL: Dediğin gibi önce devreden kısımdan düşürülsün, ardından normal izinden düşürülsün

confirmed_decisions.decision: Pregnancy leave is never assigned by the automatic entitlement worker; an authorized administrator assigns it manually and female eligibility remains enforced.
confirmed_decisions.evidence: CURRENT_USER_REQUEST: Hamilelik izni otomatik atanmasın, manuel şekilde admin atasın onu.

confirmed_decisions.decision: Carry-over limit warnings have a separate admin panel that shows carried, current entitlement and total days per employee and supports an explicit acknowledgement workflow.
